journey.name: LC-03 Rotating with the date picker open loses the dialog
journey.description:
KNOWN-DEFECT WATCHLIST. Expected to fail if the current behaviour is judged wrong; see qa/TEST-PLAN.md.
The editor holds the picker's visibility in `var picking by remember` rather than rememberSaveable (TaskEditorScreen.kt:204). remember does not survive a configuration change, so rotating while the picker is open closes it and drops the date the user had highlighted. The surrounding form survives, because that state is in the ViewModel - the dialog is the one piece that is not.
NFR-06 asks for state intact across configuration change. Whether an open dialog counts as state is the question this journey puts on the table; the one-word fix is rememberSaveable.
Preconditions: adb shell settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0 adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0
